new_control_profile: Pin EN and manually source-reviewed PT question strings before owned control execution. Reject literal substitutions; paraphrases can be correct yet refused by this narrow policy.
historical_diagnostic_profile: Original historical prompt froze EN questions, not exact PT strings. Diagnose EN question identity, fact association and required answer identifiers only; do not retroactively apply new literal PT question requirement or change historical acceptance scores.
answer_check: Nonempty bilingual answer strings and registered mandatory exact code tokens only. No lexical negation detector or general semantic claim.
outputs: Binding diagnostics plus semantic_review_required=true; never TECHNICALLY_ACCEPTED by binding alone.
